title: Feature request: Ajax loading of results / endless scroll
body: It would be nice to be able to switch from paginated results to a endless scroll list of items (automatically load on page scroll).

comments.body: Hi @synonymous1984 thanks for taking the time to fill in this issue. Can you explain how it could work UX wise? What is the trigger of such switch of behavior?

Hi @bobylito! You can read a study about infinite scroll at smashing magazine. Maybe a hybrid version is also a good idea: https://www.smashingmagazine.com/2013/05/infinite-scrolling-lets-get-to-the-bottom-of-this/
Heads up! There's no an infinite hits widget: https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/documentation/#infinite-hits
